caption: Creamy beige tonkotsu broth with visible noodles and toppings forms a shallow pool in a black ceramic bowl with a glossy surface and slight brushstroke. Chashu pork slice, pale pink and slightly glistening, rests in the broth on a wooden table with warm brown tones and grain patterns.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with a slightly glistening surface and irregular, cooked edges.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and toppings, forming a shallow, circular pool.
Black ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface and subtle brushstroke pattern, slightly raised rim.
